inputToRafMs = next rAF timestamp - event.timeStamp for real DOM input only (clamped at 0; "event -> frame that consumed it", not input-to-photon); the frame presents about one display interval later. Scripted inputs are in inputToRafScriptedMs (one frame by construction).

ttsFromLastInputMs (headline, 04 F8 TTS) = last input -> end of pop-in (last frame drawing an ancestor, blank or fading cell, + one display interval; 0 if none). sharpAfterSettleMs = camera settled (~0.5 s after a wheel burst) -> first sharp frame (A §3 target form). timeToSharpMs = first sharp frame at/after settle from the last input (>= 150 ms floor; not 04 F8 TTS). Timed-out gestures hold lower bounds (censored).

zoomInBursts = gestures with levelsZoomed > 0, not interrupted, not ending magnified (s > 1 at level 0). pinned base levels 3-5 (21 tiles), no warm base (112 layers leave fewer than 1.5 typical viewports free).
